title: Tribal Jungle Run
description: Sprint across vibrant totem canyons and jungle vines—vault over rolling boulders, double-jump chasms, and gather gleaming tribal relics.
controls: Tap jump (double-tap for higher leaps) and slide controls to dodge jungle hazards and collect coins.

zh-CN.title: 印第安快跑
zh-CN.description: 畅快横版卡通跑酷印第安快跑：化身部落勇士穿越峡谷图腾赛道，二段跳躲巨石收集宝石冲刺极限距离！
zh-CN.controls: 点击跳跃与下滑按钮灵巧翻越沿途陷阱与巨石，狂收金币挑战最远纪录。
